title: 7/16 singleton slate: the lone check (planned from a stale 19:10 start) fired at the moved-up 18:10 first pitch and the pick was never delivered
missing_evidence: a machine observation or contemporaneous report for 2026-07-16: the scheduler journal (check at 18:10, classification game_started_or_final) and the 7/16 pick file / decision record — Phase 2 Route R (journals retained from 5/11)
tier_reason: an enterable pick was never delivered and nothing alerted; the gap is unfixed, so a strong pick on a future one-game slate would be passed the same way

contract.text: An enterable pick is delivered before the entry cutoff (first pitch minus 5 minutes), also on a one-game slate whose start moves after the morning schedule fetch.
contract.source: design §10.3 (7/16 characterization); picks.SUBMISSION_CUTOFF_MIN; docs/optimization-ideas.md 'Singleton slates get zero pre-start lineup checks'

mechanism.text: compute_run_times derives every lineup check from game starts once, at the 10:00 fetch; a one-game slate gets a single check (start minus 60) and no other anchor or intermediate tick
the plan is static: MLB moved the game from 19:10 to 18:10 after the fetch, so the lone check fired at first pitch, classified the preview game_started_or_final and locked the day undelivered

residual.text: Unfixed: one-game slates still get a single check computed once from the morning schedule; no re-fetch re-anchors a moved-up start and no missed-delivery alert fires for a day ending game_started_or_final with a never-delivered pick.

watchdog.trigger: a slate whose pick game has no scheduled check before its cutoff, or whose start moved earlier after the morning plan; and at cutoff an undelivered candidate with no deliberate skip
watchdog.recovery_assertion: a check runs and the pick is delivered before first pitch minus 5, or the day is alerted as undelivered

evidence.locator: docs/optimization-ideas.md 'Singleton slates get zero pre-start lineup checks' (commit 7b70da7)
evidence.what: later write-up (11 days after): the 10:00 plan held one check at 18:10; MLB moved the game from 19:10 to 18:10; the check fired at first pitch, classified game_started_or_final, and the day locked undelivered; the only same-day signal was a log-only calibration_drift WARN
the real run_day reproduces the sequence under a truthful clock-aware schedule (strict XFAIL, accepted); with the move known at the morning fetch the same machinery delivers at 17:10
afbea38 installed 2026-07-13T04:12:55Z and not replaced until 2026-08-03: the static single-fetch planner was live on 7/16

notes: Phase 1 disposition is evidence-limited: the only repo account was written 11 days after the event (inference under design §3); Route R is expected to supply the machine observation
